breakfast.name: Jook (Thai Rice Porridge)
breakfast.description: A comforting Thai rice porridge made from jasmine rice simmered in broth until creamy, topped with savory ingredients like fried pork, soft-boiled eggs, and fresh garnishes
ingredients: Salt and white pepper to taste
instructions: Rinse jasmine rice under cold water
In large pot, bring broth and water to boil
Add rice and bring back to boil, stirring occasionally
Reduce heat to low and simmer 60-90 minutes, stirring occasionally
Rice should completely break down and porridge reach creamy consistency
Alternative: partially break dry rice grains before cooking to reduce time
Season with salt and white pepper
Pour into bowls and add desired toppings
Serve hot with various condiments on the side
breakfast.notes: Breaking dry rice grains before cooking unlocks starch and creates velvety texture. Thai jasmine rice creates signature fragrant and creamy jook
breakfast.fun_fact: Jook is the Thai version of rice porridge (congee) and is traditionally eaten for breakfast or when feeling under the weather
alternatives: Use chicken broth for richer flavor
